Laura — forwarding EdgeCommerce usage profile and the ask. High-level proposal I think we can offer:

Option A (Pilot) — 3 months
- No long-term commit
- Baseline gen: $0.016 / 1k tokens
- Embeddings: $0.010 / 1k tokens
- No discount; standard support

Option B (Growth) — 12 month commit, 50M tokens/month average
- Tiered discounts: 10% off baseline up to 50M; 18% off 50M-200M; 28% off above 200M
- Minimum MM commitment: $25k/month
- Dedicated burst + priority support included

Option C (Enterprise) — 24 month commit, 200M+ tokens/month
- Flat blended rate proposal: $0.011 / 1k tokens (blended across tiers)
- 30% discount across generation compared to baseline; embeddings 35% off
- SLA: 99.95% availability; 8-hour support for incidents; up to $X in credits for breach (TBD)

Customer wants clarity on how overage is billed (pro-rated at committed blended rate or charged at baseline). I suggested overage be billed at the next tier rate until the month end and then true-up. Also they asked about minimum sustained throughput — we can call out burst vs sustained GPU-backed throughput in the doc.
